end.parentNote: Asha practised naming polygons by counting their sides and checking that the shape is closed. Veer correctly recognised shapes even when their position or size changed, and described triangles using equal sides and angle types. They briefly mixed up the side count while working out an octagon, then corrected it by recalling that an octagon has 8 sides. At home, ask Veer to find closed polygons around the house and name each one by counting its sides.
